name: A Scribbled Letter

angles.text: Tordrin Stemblade mentors hunters in Northshire Abbey, noting how times have changed as new races take up the bow to defend Stormwind from beasts and vermin.
Training skilled defenders in Northshire Abbey helps secure Elwynn Forest against encroaching kobolds and other growing threats to the kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.answer: A Scribbled Letter is a missive delivered to adventurers in Northshire Abbey upon returning from the kobold camps. Bearing the seal of Tordrin Stemblade, it directs the recipient to seek him out for mentorship and training in the valley.
The letter was penned and sealed by Tordrin Stemblade, a local trainer stationed at Northshire Abbey who offers instruction to fledgling adventurers learning their craft.
Tordrin Stemblade is located at Northshire Abbey in the Northshire Valley. He remains stationed there day and night, ready to provide instruction and advice to travelers.
faq.q: Where can Tordrin Stemblade be found?

aliases: why did tordrin send a letter
faq.answer: After an adventurer proves their capability against the local kobolds, Tordrin sends word to ensure they receive proper training. He aims to prepare them for the escalating dangers threatening the residents of Northshire and the wider realm of Stormwind.
faq.q: Why did Tordrin Stemblade send the letter?

faq.answer: Northshire Valley faces incursions from aggressive kobold camps and dangerous man-eating beasts that roam the surrounding woods, prompting local mentors to muster and drill capable fighters.
faq.q: What threats are currently affecting Northshire?

faq.answer: Upon meeting with him, Tordrin offers continuous training and guidance, urging adventurers to learn the lay of the land and assist the local folk with the myriad troubles facing the kingdom.
faq.q: What does Tordrin Stemblade offer after receiving the letter?

sections.body: Upon returning from skirmishes with the kobold camps infesting the valley, adventurers at Northshire Abbey receive a hasty missive. Marked with the seal of Tordrin Stemblade, the note requests their prompt attention before attending to other business. The letter serves as an urgent summons to connect budding champions with formal mentorship within the abbey's protective grounds.
sections.title: A Summons in Northshire

sections.body: When presented with the letter, Tordrin Stemblade remarks on how times have changed, observing how unfamiliar folk have taken up weapons in defense of the realm. Acknowledging that the surrounding wilderness grows more hazardous by the day, he invites travelers to seek out his counsel day or night as they master their skills and assist the beleaguered people of Stormwind.
sections.title: Guidance in Perilous Times

summary: A Scribbled Letter is a summons delivered to adventurers at Northshire Abbey following their early clashes with nearby kobolds. Sent under the seal of Tordrin Stemblade, it directs promising recruits to seek out his training and guidance. The letter marks a crucial step in preparing defenders to face the escalating perils threatening the kingdom of Stormwind.
